htmlContexts.target:
Bad Form Labels - Multiple WCAG 3.3.2 & 1.3.1 Violations

This page demonstrates common form labeling failures that prevent screen reader users from understanding form controls.

VIOLATION 1: Labels not programmatically linked to inputs

Contact Form with Unlinked Labels

Problem: Labels lack 'for' attributes and inputs lack 'id' attributes!

VIOLATION 2: Placeholder text as only label

Login Form - Placeholder Only

Problem: Placeholders disappear when typing and aren't labels!

VIOLATION 3: Visual labels using wrong elements

Registration Form - Wrong Elements

First Name:

Last Name:
Date of Birth:
Choose Your Country:

Problem: Using p, div, span instead of label elements!

VIOLATION 4: Required fields not programmatically indicated

Order Form - Visual Only Required Indicators

Problem: Missing 'required' attributes or aria-required="true"!

VIOLATION 5: Instructions not linked to form controls

Account Setup - Unlinked Instructions

Must be 3-20 characters, letters and numbers only
Minimum 8 characters with at least one number and special character
Format: YYYY-MM-DD (e.g., 2024-03-15)

Problem: Instructions lack aria-describedby associations!

VIOLATION 6: Conflicting ARIA labels

Survey Form - ARIA Label Conflicts

Problem: aria-label overrides visible label text!

VIOLATION 7: Ambiguous labels for similar inputs

Address Form - Ambiguous Labels

Billing Address
Shipping Address

Problem: Multiple "Address" and "Phone" labels are confusing!

VIOLATION 8: Form controls with no labels at all

Search and Filter - Unlabeled Controls

In Stock Only Free Shipping On Sale

Problem: Multiple form controls lack any accessible names!

Expected Scanner Results

WCAG 3.3.2 & 1.3.1 Violations Found:

  • 8 unlinked labels (missing for/id associations)
  • 6 placeholder-only form controls
  • 8 visual labels using wrong elements (p, div, span)
  • 6 required fields without programmatic indicators
  • 6 instructions not linked via aria-describedby
  • 4 conflicting aria-label and visible labels
  • 8 ambiguous labels for similar controls
  • 10 form controls with no labels at all

Total Expected Violations: 56+ form labeling failures

Confidence Level: High (programmatically detectable)

VIOLATION 1: Labels not programmatically linked to inputs

Contact Form with Unlinked Labels

Problem: Labels lack 'for' attributes and inputs lack 'id' attributes!

VIOLATION 2: Placeholder text as only label

Login Form - Placeholder Only

Problem: Placeholders disappear when typing and aren't labels!

VIOLATION 3: Visual labels using wrong elements

Registration Form - Wrong Elements

First Name:

Last Name:
Date of Birth:
Choose Your Country:

Problem: Using p, div, span instead of label elements!

VIOLATION 4: Required fields not programmatically indicated

Order Form - Visual Only Required Indicators

Problem: Missing 'required' attributes or aria-required="true"!

VIOLATION 5: Instructions not linked to form controls

Account Setup - Unlinked Instructions

Must be 3-20 characters, letters and numbers only
Minimum 8 characters with at least one number and special character
Format: YYYY-MM-DD (e.g., 2024-03-15)

Problem: Instructions lack aria-describedby associations!

VIOLATION 6: Conflicting ARIA labels

Survey Form - ARIA Label Conflicts

Problem: aria-label overrides visible label text!

VIOLATION 7: Ambiguous labels for similar inputs

Address Form - Ambiguous Labels

Billing Address
Shipping Address

Problem: Multiple "Address" and "Phone" labels are confusing!

VIOLATION 8: Form controls with no labels at all

Search and Filter - Unlabeled Controls

In Stock Only Free Shipping On Sale

Problem: Multiple form controls lack any accessible names!

Expected Scanner Results

WCAG 3.3.2 & 1.3.1 Violations Found:

  • 8 unlinked labels (missing for/id associations)
  • 6 placeholder-only form controls
  • 8 visual labels using wrong elements (p, div, span)
  • 6 required fields without programmatic indicators
  • 6 instructions not linked via aria-describedby
  • 4 conflicting aria-label and visible labels
  • 8 ambiguous labels for similar controls
  • 10 form controls with no labels at all

Total Expected Violations: 56+ form labeling failures

Confidence Level: High (programmatically detectable)
